system.longDesc: Advanced materials and onboard technologies to manage battlefield data, send biometrics, and even provide first aid, have revived the use of armor. You’ve trained to manage its bulk.

degree0.desc: You ignore Armor Penalties for worn armor up to -2, but higher penalties have full effect.

degree1.desc: You ignore Armor Penalties for worn armor up to -4 but again, higher penalties have full effect.

degree2.desc: You ignore Armor Penalties for worn armor up to -6 but just as for the previous degrees, higher penalties have full effect.
